coverageSpotVerification.detail: All 58 suite-required coverage entries (M1-M6, M8) in the grader-run suite receipts were checked against their test bodies in scripts/acceptance.mjs. The lane has no registered-format coverage manifest (clique-coverage-manifest.v1); coverage lives only in each suite receipt's `coverage` array. The criterion: a mapping is honest if the mapped test exercises the assertion's behavior, even at API rather than UI level, and dishonest if it exercises a different behavior. M3 is dishonest: 5 of 7 entries map to tests of other behaviors. m3-a03 (DM reuse) maps to 'markDelivered advances to delivered'. m3-a04 (create group A/B/C) maps to 'markRead advances to read'. m3-a05 (second same-member group) maps to 'second DM create reuses the same channel'. m3-a11 (tap quoted excerpt jumps to original) maps to 'typing expires within the ceiling'. m3-a15 (seed idempotent) maps to 'admin adds a member'. Nothing in the suite exercises m3-a11 or m3-a15. The pattern looks like the builder used a different ID numbering, not deliberate misreporting, but the frozen rule is observable-based and non-retroactive. M3 is therefore adjudicated capability-failure and O1 scores its checklist not-passed. Honest but weak, API-level proxies (not dishonest): m1-a02, m1-a03, m1-a11, m2-a12, m2-a13, m4-a09 check server state rather than rendering; m8-a06 is structural because no >24 h post exists; m6-a11 pages an empty history; m8-a01 uses fresh users, not seeded content. The grader re-executed every one of these observables in the UI or via the API; see assertionResults.

defects.summary: A user who signs up through the web UI can never create a profile. /profile/edit renders 'Loading…' forever because myProfile is null for a new account, and no other screen calls upsertProfile. The account has no handle or display name, its posts show author '?', and Settings shows 'Signed in as …'.

In a DM only the creator can change disappearing, accent colour or background. The other participant is refused E_RULE because conversations.update requires the 'admin' role and dmCreate gives the counterpart 'member'. The brief says any member may change these in DMs.

defects.summary: Unfollowing an account leaves that account's reposts of third-party posts in the viewer's Following feed indefinitely. unfollowUser deletes feed rows by original authorId (byReaderAuthor), not by repostBy. This breaks the brief's unfollow projection rule.
Unfollowing author Z also deletes a still-followed account's repost of Z's post from Following, for the same authorId-keyed delete as d-03.

Un-reposting deletes only the reposter's own feed row. Followers keep orphaned Following entries (repostBy set, rp null) that the API still returns. The web client hides them, so pages render fewer than 20 rows (Following first page showed 18).

Warm-offline queued messages intermittently fail to appear within 10 s after reconnect on web. The grader's M6 web check passed 3 of 5 runs; both failures came when M6 ran right after M3 at load avg 26-83. The lane's own receipts show the M6 check failing in 6 of its 12 builder runs.

defects.summary: API.md does not state the token expiry and revocation story the brief requires (7-day sessions, POST /auth/logout, logout-all, refresh). A third-party developer cannot learn from API.md that tokens expire or how to revoke them.

The history operations do not expose the full M6 message field manifest. threadMessages lacks per-message reaction aggregates (emoji, count) and the caller's receipt state; historyPage also lacks myReaction. Clients must join convoReactions and convoAggregates themselves.
Duplicate-handle and duplicate-email errors show raw codes ('Save failed: E_CONSTRAINT', 'Authentication failed: E_AUTH') without saying the handle or email is taken.

O1.anchorsCited: Between ~30 'core features partially work; several checklist items fail' and ~60 'M1–M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap'; placed just below 60. ~90 'every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts' is far off.
O1.justification: Full-run denominator is all 119 assertions (M1-M8). Credited passes: M1 13/13, M2 27/27, M3 0/15 (14/15 observed, but the dishonest coverage mapping adjudicates M3 to capability-failure and its checklist scores not-passed), M4 12/12, M5 12/12, M6 6/13 (7 native-artifact assertions have no simulator proof), M7 0/9 (not attempted), M8 14/18 (m8-a03 UTC-day buckets and m8-a05 Trending 200-post window fail; m8-a17/a18 have no native proof). Total 84/119 = 70.6% credited (98/119 observed). M1, M2, M4 and M5 are solid, but M3 cannot count as solid, native platform proofs are absent, and iOS Hermes exports exist only for M1-M3 plus one final export. Evidence: grading/trace.md#o1.

O2.anchorsCited: Between ~30 'multiple high-severity defects in core flows' and ~60 'a few medium defects off the happy path'.
O2.justification: Three major defects: d-01 new UI signups cannot create a profile, a core onboarding flow; d-02 DM counterpart cannot set disappearing/colour/background; d-03 unfollow leaves the unfollowed account's reposts in Following. Six minor (d-04..d-09: repost projection edge cases, client-side stale feed rows, intermittent warm-offline flush, API.md token story, incomplete history field manifest) and one cosmetic (d-10). Trust boundaries held in every grader exploration: cross-user DM reads, removed-member cutoff, view-once and deleted/expired asset refusal, edit/delete windows, logout revocation, digest authorization. Only one major hits a core flow outright, so the score sits above 30. Evidence: grading/trace.md#defects.

O4.anchorsCited: Near ~30 'cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app'. The ~60 'reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush' and ~90 'reads, ordered queued writes, receipt transitions, and offline search all behave as specced on the native proof — on full runs including M8's durable-queue restart and multi-device convergence evidence' anchors both require native proof, which does not exist.
O4.justification: M6 is green (lane receipts-all5 and the grader harness run 1), so O4 applies. It is scored only from choreography receipts and simulator artifacts. No simulator artifact or simulator-status receipt exists for M6 or M8 (every segment summary has simulator=null), so cold-start offline reads, offline media, cold offline search, view-once non-caching, native queued-write ordering and the M8 durable restart are undemonstrated and cannot support a native claim. The lane makes no false native claim. The web artifacts show part of the obligation: warm-offline pending state and in-order flush (flaky, 3 of 5 grader runs; 6 of 12 builder runs failed), warm-offline search, and M8 dual-offline convergence with normal receipts (3 of 3 grader runs). That keeps the score from dropping further below the 30 anchor, but none of it is native evidence. Evidence: grading/trace.md#native, grading/trace.md#choreography.

O5 is null: the lane wrote no run record and left no scale-replay evidence (no replay receipts, checkpoint data or invariant-manifest verification). Only the M6 sample-50 conformance replay was run. The replay was never attempted, so O5 records null. Frozen schema limitation: grader-report.schema.json only admits ^m[1-7]-a[0-9]{2}$ keys, so this file holds exactly the 101 M1-M7 results. The 18 M8 results are in grading/m8-assertion-results.json with the same record shape; the two files partition all 119 manifest ids with no overlap. Nothing in the lane's own files, stores or receipts was modified.
